dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curvature following a smooth spline from the rounded apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex morphology with a medium curvature radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin rising at a steep angle relative to the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum vertical pixel height exceeds the maximum longitudinal pixel base width (ratio approx 1.15:1).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Light-colored linear striations and surface abrasions on the lateral flank of the fin; small notch-like irregularity on the trailing edge near the base.
